svg.text: AWS DevOps Agent on EKS Lab — architecture
Solid = data / alert flow · dashed purple = agent (Phase 7)
VPC 10.20.0.0/16 · 2 public subnets (1a, 1b) · IGW · no NAT
devops-agent-lab-eks · Kubernetes 1.36 · secrets encrypted with KMS
2 × t4g.medium Graviton (arm64) · AL2023 · IMDSv2 · label nodepool-type=user
store-front · order · product · makeline · store-admin · virtual-customer ·
crashloop · oom-killed · image-pull · pods-pending · node-cpu-high — Metrics
SNS → signed webhook (HMAC secret in Secrets Manager)
investigates alarms · root cause · mitigation plan
Kubernetes also creates resources outside Terraform state: the MongoDB EBS volume (PVC) and /aws/containerinsights/* log groups — see destroy.sh. Edit in draw.io: this file is a .drawio.svg.
